label: r2c1
name: Reflection head, 2 PPO epochs
hypothesis: Same as r1c1, but with ppo_epochs set to 2. Under the fixed budget this nearly doubles environment samples (about 217k versus 119k). Training success was still climbing steeply at the end, so the run is short of samples. Refuted if dev success is not above r1c1's 0.726 by more than seed noise (about 0.06), or if it drops because each sample is reused less.
last_analysis: Mirroring the features is the key fix. Models with mirrored features score 0.63–0.87, while the starting network and the learned remapping score 0.00–0.04. Under fixed compute, more fresh samples help: going from 4 to 2 PPO epochs raised dev success from 0.726 to 0.871 (r2c1). One epoch collapsed to choosing DONE immediately. Combining 2 epochs with smaller batches was unstable, with one seed at 0.27 (r3c1). With smaller batches, gamma 0.99 brought that combination back to 0.838 with stable seeds (r3c3). Remaining failures are near misses (IoU about 0.98, about 0.5 extra cells per episode), so longer-horizon credit may help. The action-frame trunk (r2c3) was cheaper and slightly better than concatenation at 4 epochs (within noise) but was never tried with the better recipe. Since this is the last round, I prefer changes to the best that should be stable across seeds.
